verdicts.go: Favourable air quality for your activity.
verdicts.caution: Moderate pollution level; consider lighter intensity.
verdicts.mask: Elevated particulate pollution; an N95/FFP2 mask is recommended.
verdicts.avoid: Unhealthy air conditions; move activity indoors if possible.

advice.skip_usual: Skip your usual {usual_time} {activity}. The cleanest window today is {best_window}.
advice.already_best: Your usual {usual_time} window is already the best choice available today ({mean_pm25} µg/m³).
advice.caution_intensity: Air will still be {category}, so keep the pace light or shorten duration.
advice.mask_required: Wear a well-fitted N95/FFP2 mask if you need to be outdoors.
advice.indoor_fallback: Air quality remains severe throughout the day. Opt for indoor exercise, an indoor gym, or keep windows closed with air filtration running.
advice.outdoor_worker_guidance: Extended shift detected. Schedule mandatory rest breaks during peak pollution hours ({avoid_window}) and wear an N95 mask throughout.

disclaimer: General air quality guidance, not medical advice. Consult a healthcare provider for personalized medical recommendations.
